description:
# claude-faf-mcp

FAF MCP server for Claude-compatible clients, with 33 tools for creating, validating, scoring, and syncing `.faf` Project DNA files.

Install: `npm install -g claude-faf-mcp`

It helps reduce AI context drift by making project context operations structured and repeatable across sessions and IDE agents.

GitHub: https://github.com/Wolfe-Jam/claude-faf-mcp  
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/claude-faf-mcp  
Smithery (auto-CLI): https://smithery.ai/servers/wolfe-jam/claude-faf-mcp

![claude-faf-mcp logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wolfe-Jam/claude-faf-mcp/main/faf-logo.png)

tool_signatures.name: create_soul
tool_signatures.description: Create a new soul with initial content. Admin-only operation.

tool_signatures.name: delete_soul
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a soul from storage. Admin-only operation.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion

tool_signatures.name: delta_check
tool_signatures.description: Determine if a topic needs FULL, DELTA, or X-DELTA soul.

tool_signatures.name: faf_analyze
tool_signatures.description: One-call composite — returns score, tier-ready, valid, and engine identifier. Two WASM calls, sub-millisecond total.

tool_signatures.name: faf_collections_search
tool_signatures.description: Phase III (FRC §7b) — semantic search over a Grok Collection at the edge, KV-cached (1h TTL). Returns matched chunks (content, score, file). Requires the XAI_API_KEY secret; composes with faf_section (structural) for hybrid retrieval. Handled env-aware in the MCP handler (needs the key + KV).

collection_id.description: The Grok Collection id to search.

text.description: Matched collection chunks with scores and cache status.

tool_signatures.name: faf_estimate_tokens
tool_signatures.description: Estimate token count for arbitrary content via the Zig WASM engine. Sub-millisecond, zero allocations. Useful for context-budget planning.

tool_signatures.name: faf_gate
tool_signatures.description: Phase III (FRC) — pre-promotion quality gate. Scores .faf content (edge Mk4) + estimates tokens and returns a deterministic promote/hold verdict BEFORE it goes to a Grok Collection. Promote IFF score >= min_score AND tokens <= max_tokens (defaults 85/8000). Edge parity with the local gate; the hold-hint can't list empty slots at the edge.

tool_signatures.name: faf_get_tier
tool_signatures.description: Resolve the FAF tier for a given numeric score. Returns the tier symbol (Trophy/Gold/Silver/Bronze/etc.) per the canonical tier-table.

tool_signatures.name: faf_memory
tool_signatures.description: Phase III (FRC) — query the durable .fafm model by type/tag/priority/text. Omit filters for a structured summary. .fafm is NOT scored: this SELECTS facts (provenance preserved), never grades them.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring match on fact text.

tool_signatures.name: faf_orchestrate_recommendation
tool_signatures.description: Takes raw content strings (`.faf`, `.fafm`, and optionally `package.json`/`CHANGELOG.md`/`README.md`) and runs deterministic drift + contradiction signals across the FAF substrate. Returns a structured `Recommendation` (recommend, severity, reason, summary) with `hints` containing the current `effective_policy` and `partial[]` for any stateful signals unavailable on the current surface. Light-lane execution (hosted) is WASM-pure with no filesystem access. Heavy-lane execution (local via bunx/rust-faf-mcp) has full FS + persisted state. Advisory only — never auto-fires.

faf.description: Raw .faf YAML content (project DNA). Required for any meaningful analysis.

fafm.description: Raw .fafm YAML content (memory layer). Enables drift detection.

readme.description: Raw README.md content. Enables README arch-tree cross-stamp checks.

changelog.description: Raw CHANGELOG.md content. Enables changelog cross-stamp checks.

packageJson.description: Raw package.json content. Enables version cross-stamp checks (.faf vs pkg).

text.description: Orchestration summary plus embedded Recommendation JSON.

tool_signatures.name: faf_score
tool_signatures.description: Score .faf YAML content via the Mk4 Zig-WASM engine. Returns 0-100 (capped). Same engine as xai-faf-rust + xai-faf-zig (parity-tested). Sub-ms at the edge.

content.description: Raw .faf YAML content. Souls with a [faf] section have it extracted automatically.

tool_signatures.name: faf_section
tool_signatures.description: Phase III (FRC) — returns an EXACT, WHOLE .faf section by dotted path (e.g. "stack", "human_context"), structure preserved — the deterministic complement to blind chunking. Omit "section" to list every path.

section.description: Dotted path to retrieve (e.g. "stack.backend"). Omit to list all paths.

tool_signatures.name: faf_validate
tool_signatures.description: Validate .faf YAML content via the Mk4 Zig-WASM engine. Returns true if mission-ready (>= 100).

tool_signatures.name: generate_faf_from_github
tool_signatures.description: Generate a .faf file from any public GitHub repository WITHOUT cloning. Extracts 6 Ws from README, analyzes stack from languages and package.json, and generates Championship-grade AI context. Returns .faf content, quality score, and metadata.

repo.description: GitHub repository URL or owner/repo format (e.g., "facebook/react" or "https://github.com/facebook/react")

tool_signatures.name: get_soul
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a context soul by name. Returns structured AI context.

tool_signatures.name: list_souls
tool_signatures.description: List all available context souls.

tool_signatures.name: list_tags
tool_signatures.description: List all unique tags used in a soul, with counts.

tool_signatures.name: refresh_faf
tool_signatures.description: Re-ground on .faf content — re-score via the Mk4 Zig-WASM Enterprise scorer (33-slot, honors the authored app-type shape), report drift vs an optional baseline score, and return a stamped re-ground. The explicit re-grounding primitive for long sessions: drift → refresh → re-grounded. Built for Grok, by request.

content.description: Raw .faf YAML content to re-ground on.

baseline.description: Optional last-known score (0-100). When provided, the drift delta (current - baseline) is reported.

verbatim.description: When true, return the full .faf content verbatim with the stamp. Default false (stamped delta + summary).

tool_signatures.name: search_by_tag
tool_signatures.description: Find all entries in a soul with a specific tag.

tool_signatures.name: search_context
tool_signatures.description: Full-text search across souls. Returns matching lines only (token-efficient).

soul.description: Specific soul (optional, searches all if omitted)

tool_signatures.name: tag_intel
tool_signatures.description: Discover tag patterns, co-occurrence, candidates, and merge suggestions across all namepoints. Optionally suggest tags for a specific handle.

handle.description: Optional: suggest tags for this specific namepoint

tool_signatures.name: update_soul
tool_signatures.description: Replace entire content of an existing soul. Admin-only operation.

tool_signatures.name: write_soul
tool_signatures.description: Append an entry to a soul or replace it entirely. Entries can be typed as note, fact, todo, or question.

fact.description: Shorthand for entry with type=fact (backwards compatible)
